meaning: Treat a resolved listed security/session with no applicable event in the reconciled retained provider union as a no-event session for historical reconstruction.
conditions: Verify immutable full-window capture queries, receipts, source bindings and completed pagination.
Reconcile every original provider record; separately resolve conflicts, complex events and undated records before admitting affected histories.
Require resolved dated identities; no ticker-only joins or automatic issuer exclusions.
Record capture time, query time basis, review identities and this assumption in every consumer declaration.
Reject unresolved affected dates rather than silently assigning factor one.
Keep historical publication and provider completeness unverified; do not represent the assumption as proof.
Require separate stock entitlement, payment/settlement and option-deliverable evidence for holdings.
known_limit: Alpaca queries process dates and does not guarantee timely availability. A completed capture cannot prove absence of events not reported by either provider.
